issue.body:
### ❓ Is your feature request related to a problem?

Once a message with a link embed is sent, there's no way to get rid of the embed without deleting the whole message.

### ✨ Describe the solution you'd like

Add a way to remove embeds individually: a normal click removes a single embed with a confirm dialog, shift+click skips the confirm, and shift+ctrl+click removes all embeds on a message with no confirm.

issue.title: Refactor card classes for consistent dashboard components
issue.body:
This pull request applies a set of CSS fixes to ensure visual consistency across the StudioCMS dashboard after upgrading to Astro v7. The main change is the addition of the `sui-card` class to all relevant `Card` components in the dashboard and user management pages, which addresses layout and styling issues introduced by the upgrade.

- Fixes #1684 

Dashboard and profile component updates:

* Added the `sui-card` class to `Card` components in the following dashboard/profile files to fix styling issues: `APITokens.astro`, `BasicInfo.astro`, `Notifications.astro`, `SocialSignin.astro`, and `UpdatePassword.astro` [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-e93afd43eb83feff085770995c482fc6520957e151ece52ac076163f7e38befaL31-R31) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-3825877b6250870b2ce607ee1c55ec70126d45b0731d6d9b3ced01bd78361665L20-R20) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-ce19cd9d57a7deea0a3d60a92bebd4b4ddb97cf0260bc52b3fedb1ecbcc51776L61-R61) [[4]](diffhunk://#diff-9a304b1b822d2f9418e0aa74ba73c8c38a59ea15537cb0154aeacf20dba8c41cL54-R54) [[5]](diffhunk://#diff-5014f78cb02ffa7c99811efb43dc491ed1021707b6222b3fe68b9fb6169c9b3fL25-R25).

User management page updates:

* Updated `Card` components in `user-mgmt/SocialSignin.astro` and multiple locations in `user-management/edit.astro` to include the `sui-card` class for consistent appearance ([packages/studiocms/frontend/components/dashboard/user-mgmt/SocialSignin.astroL43-R43](diffhunk://#diff-e102632c6dc32db2bc176c69ab93226b1b02a22ad5e193f3d5638fb6261a3cd0L43-R43), [packages/studiocms/frontend/pages/[dashboard]/user-management/edit.astroL148-R148](diffhunk://#diff-073d8be21af24f78624a526658134ef0e6784dbdeffdbe22bb8762dbdbb4f739L148-R148), [packages/studiocms/frontend/pages/[dashboard]/user-management/edit.astroL230-R230](diffhunk://#diff-073d8be21af24f78624a526658134ef0e6784dbdeffdbe22bb8762dbdbb4f739L230-R230), [packages/studiocms/frontend/pages/[dashboard]/user-management/edit.astroL251-R251](diffhunk://#diff-073d8be21af24f78624a526658134ef0e6784dbdeffdbe22bb8762dbdbb4f739L251-R251), [packages/studiocms/frontend/pages/[dashboard]/user-management/edit.astroL268-R268](diffhunk://#diff-073d8be21af24f78624a526658134ef0e6784dbdeffdbe22bb8762dbdbb4f739L268-R268), [packages/studiocms/frontend/pages/[dashboard]/user-management/edit.astroL283-R283](diffhunk://#diff-073d8be21af24f78624a526658134ef0e6784dbdeffdbe22bb8762dbdbb4f739L283-R283)).

Documentation:

* Added a changeset file to document these CSS fixes for Astro v7 compatibility.
